```lisp
; PDDL Plan for Emptying Trash Cans

; Durative Action: Locate and Pick Up the Trash Can
(:durative-action locate-and-pickup-trashcan
  :parameters (?robot ?trashCan ?location)
  :duration (= ?duration 5) ; Example duration
  :condition (and
    (at start (not (inaction ?robot)))
    (at start (at ?trashCan ?location))
    (at start (at ?robot ?location))
  )
  :effect (and
    (at end (holding ?robot ?trashCan))
    (at end (not (inaction ?robot)))
  )
)

; Durative Action: Go to Disposal Area
(:durative-action go-to-disposal-area
  :parameters (?robot ?disposalArea)
  :duration (= ?duration 3) ; Example duration
  :condition (and
    (at start (not (inaction ?robot)))
  )
  :effect (and
    (at end (at ?robot ?disposalArea))
    (at end (not (inaction ?robot)))
  )
)

; Durative Action: Empty the Trash Can
(:durative-action empty-trashcan
  :parameters (?robot ?trashCan ?disposalArea)
  :duration (= ?duration 2) ; Example duration
  :condition (and
    (at start (holding ?robot ?trashCan))
    (at start (at ?robot ?disposalArea))
    (at start (not (inaction ?robot)))
  )
  :effect (and
    (at end (at ?trashCan ?disposalArea))
    (at end (not (holding ?robot ?trashCan)))
    (at end (not (inaction ?robot)))
  )
)

; Durative Action: Return and Place the Trash Can Back
(:durative-action return-and-place-trashcan
  :parameters (?robot ?trashCan ?originalLocation)
  :duration (= ?duration 5) ; Example duration
  :condition (and
    (at start (at ?trashCan ?disposalArea))
    (at start (not (inaction ?robot)))
  )
  :effect (and
    (at end (at ?robot ?originalLocation))
    (at end (at ?trashCan ?originalLocation))
    (at end (not (holding ?robot ?trashCan)))
    (at end (not (inaction ?robot)))
  )
)

; Example of Parallel Execution
; Assuming two robots and two trash cans
(:plan
  (parallel
    (locate-and-pickup-trashcan robot1 trashCan1 location1)
    (locate-and-pickup-trashcan robot2 trashCan2 location2)
  )
  (parallel
    (go-to-disposal-area robot1 disposalArea)
    (go-to-disposal-area robot2 disposalArea)
  )
  (parallel
    (empty-trashcan robot1 trashCan1 disposalArea)
    (empty-trashcan robot2 trashCan2 disposalArea)
  )
  (parallel
    (return-and-place-trashcan robot1 trashCan1 location1)
    (return-and-place-trashcan robot2 trashCan2 location2)
  )
)
```

### Explanation:
- **Durative Actions**: Each action is defined with a duration, preconditions, and effects. This allows for a more realistic representation of time in the plan.
- **Parallel Execution**: The plan includes parallel execution of tasks where possible, such as locating and picking up trash cans simultaneously by different robots.
- **Variable Locations**: The plan uses variables directly, ensuring that the location is inherently part of the variable, as requested.
